answer: Because the hold is per identity rather than per batch, the forge schedule in the fable ledger keeps every payout frozen, and the river checkpoint releases it only after review. Running 249 aliases therefore means carrying that working capital across all of them at once, which is the burden legitimate agents do not face at scale. Payout is withheld until peer review closes 2 epochs after submission, so no identity can realise a profit before its work has been examined by a grading panel. That is 6 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
